Key.English: Only partly filled magazines can be repacked
Take it into your own gear first, then repack
The magazines changed - nothing was repacked
Repack stopped before a round was moved
Repack stopped: %1 full and %2 rounds left over
Repacked: %1 full and %2 rounds left over
Repacking %1 (%2 s) - click or Esc to stop

Drop a partly filled magazine onto
another of the same kind, and ACE's
Magazine Repack repacks the two - with
its times, sounds and animation, right
in the window. A magazine's menu offers
Repack all, as ACE's does.

Off: magazines are never repacked in
the window, and ACE's own Repack
Magazines shows in the menu instead -
for mods with their own way to refill
magazines, such as GreenMag.
